title: Serene Bath for Self-Care
summary: This prompt creates a serene and calming image of a beautifully drawn bath for a self-care post. It uses candles for warm ambiance and emphasizes advanced lighting to invite relaxation and unwinding.
prompt: A serene and calming image for a post about self-care and mental health. The scene is a beautifully drawn bath with flower petals floating on the water.
